decisions.reason: The manuscript-wide punctuation rule does not designate a new authoritative source file or change the requirement to preserve client updates in formatted versions.
The source establishes a general copyediting check but does not change the dedication text or its requested deletions.
Checking manuscript text for consecutive full stops does not alter illustration selection, placement, sizing, or rendering requirements.
The source does not identify or change the copyright page's content, alignment, email, or website requirements.
The punctuation check does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization rules.
The source does not resolve or modify the uncertain interior title-page layout.
The manuscript-wide punctuation rule does not alter trim size, paragraph spacing, page density, or other interior layout state.
The source concerns consecutive full stops and does not change the italic styling of Mama's Hot Take callouts.
The punctuation rule has no effect on table-of-contents page numbering or its update timing.
The source addresses manuscript text punctuation and does not modify the paperback cover artifact, content, dimensions, or review requirement.
The consecutive-full-stop rule does not change the separate prohibition on a literal newline artifact in the book title.
The manuscript punctuation check does not alter KDP upload assistance, workflow, or troubleshooting guidance.
